channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: They built an office atop a dead post office in Burlingame. Now it’s fully leased
item.description: Two developers transformed a historic landmark into the Peninsula city’s tallest building by working with officials, not around them.

item.title: SF is in the middle of a martini arms race. This bar just got the bomb
item.description: Frankie’s is a project from the team behind Norcina, with an unrivaled commitment to serving the best gin cocktail in the city. Oh, and it has the best dog ever.

item.title: New sexual harassment claim adds to decade-long pattern at de Young Museum
item.description: A security guard alleges her supervisor made repeated sexual comments and the museum failed to investigate, marking the ninth lawsuit since 2016.

item.title: UCSF workers march to chancellor’s door with safety demands after colleague’s killing
item.description: The stabbing death of Alberto Rangel in December is the most tragic example of a widespread workplace safety crisis, UCSF workers say.

item.title: Behind the story: How we investigated alleged sex crimes of an SF social climber
item.description: Emilia London says Michael “Mickey” Gerold coerced her into sex work to fund his lavish lifestyle. Reporter Anya Schultz tells the story.

item.title: Steve Kerr’s coaching masterpiece shows how much he still means to the Warriors
item.description: Seven Golden State players making a combined $161 million were sidelined on Thursday. The Warriors beat the Rockets in overtime anyway.

item.title: Lurie’s bodyguards injured during Tenderloin scuffle
item.description: The mayor was unhurt after two suspects were arrested in the Cedar Street fracas Thursday evening.

item.title: Buster Posey believes a rising group of Giants prospects will be different
item.description: The team’s top baseball executive chose to keep Bryce Eldridge, Josuar Gonzalez, and other highly regarded prospects out of trades this offseason.

item.title: ‘Section 415’ podcast: The Giants’ biggest issues to settle before Opening Day
item.description: With less than three weeks until the Yankees arrive at Oracle Park, top prospect Bryce Eldridge is pushing for a spot on the 26-man roster.

item.title: Lurie’s man-on-the-street routine meets a stark reality in the Tenderloin
item.description: Mayor Daniel Lurie has been seen in candid moments kneeling on the street to offer services. A violent incident on Thursday calls that practice into question.
